description.content: Retrieves the catalogue of Products available for purchase.

variable.description: (Required) ID of the customer. It could be MSISDN, email address, or any other customer identifier

response.name: Product Catalogue object. For a successfull request, the response will contain all the products available. If a product type does not have any requested data, then those fields will be null. E.g. if the product type (e.g. Data) does not have products, then the data field will be an empty list.
